menu.deleteBody: The Space and its sections go. Everything its rows open stays where it is, and the workspace's own sidebar shows again.

view.emptyHint: Add sections and rows from any of your workspaces.

editor.name: Name
editor.structureHint: Drag rows and sections by their grip, or focus the grip and press Alt with an arrow key.
editor.emptySection: No rows yet. Pick some under Add from.
editor.noCollab: Collab is off in {{workspace}}, so its mail can't be added.
editor.marksHint: Rows of a workspace other than the one open carry its small badge.

starter.title: Starter Space
